translations.asad: OH, THE LAYING-BARE of the truth!
translations.sahih: The Inevitable Reality -

translations.asad: How awesome that laying-bare of the truth!
translations.sahih: What is the Inevitable Reality?

translations.asad: And what could make thee conceive what that laying-bare of the truth will be?
translations.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?

translations.asad: THE LIE gave [the tribes of] Thamud and ‘Ad to [all tidings of] that sudden calamity!
translations.sahih: Thamud and 'Aad denied the Striking Calamity.

translations.asad: Now as for the Thamud - they were destroyed by a violent upheaval [of the earth];
translations.sahih: So as for Thamud, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].

text.arabic: وَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍۢ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍۢ

translations.asad: and as for the ‘Ad - they were destroyed by a storm wind furiously raging,
translations.sahih: And as for 'Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind

text.arabic: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍۢ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًۭا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍۢ

translations.asad: which He willed against them for seven nights and eight days without cease, so that in the end thou couldst see those people laid low [in death], as though they were so many [uprooted] trunks of hollow palm trees:
translations.sahih: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.

translations.asad: and dost thou now see any remnant of them?
translations.sahih: Then do you see of them any remains?

text.arabic: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ

translations.asad: And there was Pharaoh, too, and [many of] those who lived before him, and the cities that were overthrown - [all of them] indulged in sin upon sin
translations.sahih: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.

text.arabic: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةًۭ رَّابِيَةً

translations.asad: and rebelled against their Sustainer's apostles: and so He took them to task with a punishing grasp exceedingly severe!
translations.sahih: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].

text.arabic: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ

translations.asad: [And] behold: when the waters [of Noah's flood] burst beyond all limits, it was We who caused you to be borne [to safety] in that floating ark,
translations.sahih: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship

text.arabic: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةًۭ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌۭ وَٰعِيَةٌۭ

translations.asad: so that We might make all this a [lasting] reminder to you all, and that every wide-awake ear might consciously take it in.
translations.sahih: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.

text.arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ

translations.asad: Hence, [bethink yourselves of the Last Hour,] when the trumpet [of judgment] shall be sounded with a single blast,
translations.sahih: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast

text.arabic: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ

translations.asad: and the earth and the mountains shall be lifted up and crushed with a single stroke!
translations.sahih: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow -

translations.asad: And so, that which must come to pass will on that day have come to pass;
translations.sahih: Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur,

translations.asad: and the sky will be rent asunder - for, frail will it have become on that Day -;
translations.sahih: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.

text.arabic: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ ثَمَٰنِيَةٌۭ

translations.asad: and the angels [will appear] at its ends, and, above them, eight will bear aloft on that Day the throne of thy Sustainer’s almightiness…
translations.sahih: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].

text.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌۭ

translations.asad: On that Day you shall be brought to judgment: not [even] the most hidden of your deeds will remain hidden.
translations.sahih: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.

text.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَٰبِيَهْ

translations.asad: Now as for him whose record shall be placed in his right hand, he will exclaim: "Come you all!" Read this my record!
translations.sahih: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!

translations.asad: Behold, I did know that [one day] I would have to face my account!
translations.sahih: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."

translations.asad: And so he will find himself in a happy state of life,
translations.sahih: So he will be in a pleasant life -

translations.asad: in a lofty paradise,
translations.sahih: In an elevated garden,

translations.asad: with its fruits within easy reach.
translations.sahih: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.

text.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ

translations.asad: [And all who are thus blest will be told:] "Eat and drink with good cheer in return for all [the good deeds] that you have sent ahead in days gone by!"
translations.sahih: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."

text.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهْ

translations.asad: But as for him whose record shall be placed in his left hand, he will exclaim: "Oh, would that I had never been shown this my record,
translations.sahih: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record

translations.asad: and neither known this my account!
translations.sahih: And had not known what is my account.

translations.asad: Oh, would that this [death of mine] had been the end of me!
translations.sahih: I wish my death had been the decisive one.

translations.asad: Of no avail to me is all that I have [ever] possessed,
translations.sahih: My wealth has not availed me.

translations.asad: [and] all my power of argument has died away from me!"
translations.sahih: Gone from me is my authority."

translations.asad: Thereupon the command will go forth:] "Lay hold of him, and shackle him,
translations.sahih: [Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him.

translations.asad: and then let him enter hell,
translations.sahih: Then into Hellfire drive him.

text.arabic: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍۢ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًۭا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ

translations.asad: and then thrust him into a chain [of other sinners like him - a chain] the length whereof is seventy cubits:
translations.sahih: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."

text.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

translations.asad: for, behold, he did not believe in God, the Tremendous,
translations.sahih: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah, the Most Great,

translations.asad: and did not feel any urge to feed the needy:
translations.sahih: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.

translations.asad: and so, no friend has here today,
translations.sahih: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend

translations.asad: nor any food save the filth
translations.sahih: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;

translations.asad: which none but the sinners eat!"
translations.sahih: None will eat it except the sinners.

translations.asad: BUT NAY! I call to witness an that you can see,
translations.sahih: So I swear by what you see

translations.asad: as well as all that you cannot see!
translations.sahih: And what you do not see

translations.asad: Behold, this [Qur’an] is indeed the [inspired] word of a noble apostle,
translations.sahih: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is the word of a noble Messenger.

text.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.asad: and is not – however little you may [be prepared to] believe it - the word of a poet;
translations.sahih: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.

text.arabic: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.asad: and neither is it - however little you may [be prepared to] take it to heart - the word of a soothsayer:
translations.sahih: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.

translations.asad: [it is] a revelation from the Sustainer of all the worlds.
translations.sahih: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

translations.asad: Now if he [whom We have entrusted with it] had dared to attribute some [of his own] sayings unto Us,
translations.sahih: And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings,

translations.asad: We would indeed have seized him by his right hand,
translations.sahih: We would have seized him by the right hand;

translations.asad: and would indeed have cut his life-vein.
translations.sahih: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.

text.arabic: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَٰجِزِينَ

translations.asad: and none of you could have saved him!
translations.sahih: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.

translations.asad: And, verily, this [Qur’an] is a reminder to all the God-conscious!
translations.sahih: And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous.

translations.asad: And, behold, well do We know that among you are such as will give the lie to it:
translations.sahih: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.

translations.asad: yet, behold, this [rejection] will indeed become a source of bitter regret for all who deny the truth [of God's revelation] –
translations.sahih: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.

translations.asad: for, verily, it is truth absolute!
translations.sahih: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.

translations.asad: Extol, then the limitless glory of thy Sustainer's mighty name!
translations.sahih: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
